title: Environment specification check: Kaggle base image v173 + pinned pip packages (Docker build optional, printed only)

origin.basis: DESIGN 4.0 env_docker. The advisor's decision (no more Docker work) turns the stage into an environment check: it records the interpreter / library versions and the full package list (pip_freeze.txt) of whatever machine runs it and compares them with docker/constraints-kaggle-v173.txt (= the pins of the copied Dockerfile). It prints the docker build commands of the reference Dockerfile without running them.

verify.note: every pinned package that is installed has the pinned version (warning only: a Kaggle image newer than v173 differs)
